title: Domain property of strict henselization divisor quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring and f in R such that R/(f) is regular. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and barY : Spec Ω → Spec R a geometric point. Let b : R → strictHenselizationRing barY induce the canonical strict henselization structural morphism on spectra. If b(f) is not a unit, then strictHenselizationRing barY/(b(f)) is a domain.

source.place: Tag 00NP (regular local rings are domains); local structure of the canonical strict henselization

proof.text: Identify the small and full affine-neighbourhood colimits using smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso. The final-functor coprojection formula and the defining structural-map equations show that Spec of the comparison followed by the small structural map is strictLocalizationToBase. Compose b with the comparison; its inverse preserves the nonunit hypothesis. Apply the retained upstream regularity component to this composite. Ideal.quotientEquiv for the inverse comparison identifies the two principal quotients, and IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv transports regularity back to the original small-colimit quotient. Then use the canonical local structure theorem. The nonunit hypothesis and Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top make the principal ideal proper. Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff and IsLocalRing.of_surjective' make the quotient nontrivial and local. Apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_isRegularRing_of_isLocalRing and the proved regular-local-domain instance.
